tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH counts AS (
  SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
  FROM Genre g
  LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
  GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
),
maxcnt AS (SELECT MAX(TrackCount) AS MaxCount FROM counts)
SELECT c.GenreId, c.Name, c.TrackCount, CASE WHEN c.TrackCount = m.MaxCount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMax
FROM counts c CROSS JOIN maxcnt m
ORDER BY c.TrackCount DESC;"}
